subject: [RFC PATCH v3 13/14] mm/memcontrol, sched/numa: Gate NUMA promotions into memcg tiers

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new condition to gate NUMA promotions into memcg tiers, preventing unnecessary throttling of memory allocations when the destination node has sufficient headroom and the memcg tier is not at its limit. The change adds an additional check in the should_numa_migrate_memory function to consider memcg tier fullness before allowing un-ratelimited promotions. This patch only takes effect on systems with tiered memcg limits enabled, making it a targeted solution for specific use cases.
